id.description: Unique module ID as defined by a developer in the manifest.json file of the module. Required for create operations.

relative_path.description: Path to the directory of the module relative to the directory of the Zabbix frontend. Possible values: widgets/* - for built-in widget modules; modules/* - for third-party modules. Required for create operations.

status.description: Whether the module is enabled or disabled. Possible values: 0 - (default) Disabled; 1 - Enabled.
